correctness.rationale: For UT4(F_q), direct upper-unitriangular multiplication and two commutators give the central 2-Engel polynomial z=aBC-2bAC+cAB in six independently uniform first-superdiagonal coordinates. For fixed (A,B,C), the linear map in (a,b,c) is identically zero for t_q=q²+q−1 triples when characteristic 2, and t_q=3q−2 triples when odd; other triples have uniform q² fibers. This derives the full word-value distribution. For p≠3 a p-group has only identity with X³=I; for p=3, (I+N)³=I+abc E14, so cube identity iff abc=0. Counting (A,B,C) by 0/1,2,3 nonzero entries produces exact joint zero count q²(6q²−8q+3) and each nonzero count 3q²(q−1)² among six-coordinate pairs; subtracting yields equal (q−1)³q² fibers conditional on X³≠I. Marginals sum correctly. Independently derived trilinear commutator by symbolic 4×4 matrix multiplication and checked six-coordinate distributions for q=2,3,5 (q3: Wzero 369/729, joint cube-zero 297/729 and each nonzero 108/729). These finite checks support but do not replace field-uniform counting.
